games.description: In the Irish myth cycles, the land of Tír na nÓg is the realm of the Otherworld, the place where the Fairies lived and heroes visited on quests. Mix and match them however you wish—each brings fresh twists, daring choices, and unexpected challenges. Gear up your goats, sabotage your so-called “friends”, and unleash chaos so marvelous it’ll make even the most stoic goat bleat. games.description: Valheim: The Board Game is a 1-4 player cooperative board game where survival depends on teamwork and strategy. The fate of Valheim lies in your hands!

games.name: Kindred Spirits
games.description: Players use their Kindred Spirits to obtain magical energies on the ethereal plains. The ethereal plain is the area where magical energy gathers, collects & can be harvested from. games.name: Solo Act

games.name: The Terror
games.description: ‘The Terror’ is a historical board game set at the height of the French Revolution… A time of blood and conspiracy, when friends betrayed friends, and no one was safe from the blade of the Guillotine.The game is based on the actual story of the French Revolution. games.name: A Faeseeker's Guide to Avallen
games.description: A Faeseeker’s Guide to Avallen is the new folkloric fantasy sourcebook of faerie courts, lost artifacts, and Iron Age adventure for the Celtic TTRPG Legends of Avallen, as well as 5th Edition and its 2024 release!

games.description: PLACE - FLIP - CONTROLEvery battle has two sides… literally!Place your tiles, flip the battlefield, and outthink your opponent in this fast, tactical 1-on-1 showdown!With multiple game modes - from all-out warfare to capture the flag and tight close-quarters skirmishes - no two battles play the same.Easy to learn, quick to play, and dangerously addictive.Flip fast. games.name: FlipWars Honor & Shadow
games.description: Every battle has two sides… literally.This set can be played standalone or combined with any other FlipWars pack.Claim your ground, flip the tiles, and outthink your opponent in a fast, tactical 1-on-1 duel.With multiple game modes - from sacred strongholds to ruined keeps- no two clashes play out the same way.Easy to learn, quick to play, and dangerously addictive.Flip with honor. games.name: Ludicurrus
games.description: Welcome to Ludicurrus! The vibrant, fast-paced chariot racing board game that hurls you straight into the chaos of the Circus Maximus!Every turn is a gamble in the hands of the gods - will they bless your ambition, or curse you back to your last checkpoint? So grab the reins, embrace the madness, and prepare for a ludicrous battle of speed and wit!

games.name: Crown of Ash - Monuments Expansion
games.description: Train your minions to enhance their abilities and build monuments to unlock powerful upgrades. Bringing all new strategic options!

games.description: Fate of Witches is a competitive coven-building card game for 1–4 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering power

games.name: Flamecraft: Dragons & Dragons
games.description: The town grows with Dragons & Dragons, an expansion for Flamecraft!The gates have opened and MORE dragons have come to town. This expansion brings a variety of modules that you can add into Flamecraft to mix up gameplay. Introduce hybrid dragons with fiery powers, new adventurers, shops, companions and a new way to play the park!Dragons & Dragons is a must have for fans of Flamecraft so check it our at our booth!

games.name: Flamecraft: Dragons of the Past Promo Pack
games.description: Visit a collection of enchanting shops that have magically appeared in town! This bundle includes all the past promos for Flamecraft from the original Kickstarter, as well as a handful released after. Browse the shops and enjoy more variety in town! If you missed out on any of these promos for your copy of Flamecraft then this bundle is an excellent way to complete your collection. Dragons of the Past will be at our booth for £10 each, but we have a deal where it is £5 if purchased with any other item - so time to treat yourself!

games.name: Flamecraft Duals
games.description: Ever wondered what the dragons of Flamecraft do on their lunch break? Play Flamecraft Duals, of course! Set in the world of Flamecraft, Duals is a two-player travel-friendly game of pattern-making and quick, puzzly fun! You will meet the artisan dragons again with new powers, and this time the challenge is to get your dragons in a row. As you draw dragons, you might get lucky and come across a rare dual-colored Hydragon, with double the artisanal skills! As you play, the board will fill up with adorable dragons, stacking and soaring across the table, and you will work to fire-up their abilitie

games.name: Whisperwood
games.description: Whisperwood is a bag-building game for 2-4 players of druids harnessing the power of the elements and the natural world to restore a forest. Each round players simultaneously summon magical energy in the form of tokens and plan the incantations they will perform. The players then perform their incantations in turn order, restoring air, water and earth, partnering with wildlife, inscribing runes and awakening the Guardian Golems to perform magical tasks. games.name: Bake!
games.description: The latest, and tastiest, prototype game from Trywin Games!Come and try out the fast to learn, baking-themed card game!

games.name: Adventurer's Apprentice - The Big Bad
games.description: "The town is in danger from a big, bad... well, you'll need to see it to believe it. Help us to keep the town safe. You must use everything you have learned in your training as our apprentice." - The AdventurersThis is an interactive fantasy children's book where the roll of a dice and infinite imagination allow for the story to change every time you read together. Complete this book with one 6-sided dice, pencil and paper. Suitable for multiple apprentices to play, guided by the Reader.

games.name: Adventurer's Apprentice - The Wobbly Dummy
games.description: "The Wobbly Dummy may look silly, but don't be fooled. You will need wisdom, strength and magic to come out on top. Choose your equipment wisely and show me that you and your friends are ready to take the next step in your training to becoming great adventurers... like me!" - The AdventurerThis is an interactive fantasy children's book where the roll of a dice and infinite imagination allow for the story to change every time you read together. Complete this book with one 6-sided dice, pencil and paper. Suitable for multiple apprentices to play, guided by the Reader.

games.name: Escape From Pompeii
games.description: Race through the streets of ancient Pompeii to earn the favour of the gods and escape before Mount Vesuvius erupts! Manipulate the destruction of the board, and use events and trivia cards to your advantage.

games.name: Journey From Troy: Odysseus
games.description: Guide Odysseus home, through treacherous seas and trials fated by the gods, to reclaim Ithaca! Players must work together as they follow the story of one of the world’s oldest surviving works of literature.Escape monsters, defeat suitors, and encounter epic challenges, as you race against the timer of Penelope’s loom.

games.name: Don't Get The Duck
games.description: How to play?It's simple.DON'T GET THE DUCKHe is very tired after a long day of learning to swim, and if you get him you lose the game.However along the way enjoy seeing what other animals you can find and even come up with your own unique games!

games.name: One Room One Shots
games.description: One Room One Shots is a collection of four adventures themed around a single room or structure. There are no complex castles or labyrinthine dungeons for players to get lost in, just a single location. That means you can dive into the adventure in a single session with little to no prep - perfect for giving new players a taste of the game, or for that legendary night when everyone in your party is finally free, but no-one has had time to plan more! The adventures themselves combine combat encounters, puzzles and role-playing that all tie into the theme of the room. Each adventure con

games.name: Teleporting Towers
games.description: Build and upgrade your tower, capture artifacts, or fight to the death as a mysterious teleporter warps reality and the world around you. Teleporting Towers is a new strategy board game designed by Aiden Ellero from Sydney, Australia. It is inspired by Chess, Catan, and Cosmic Encounter.

games.name: Candy Tap!
games.description: It's a mysterious box full of candy. What candy will you get?Candy Tap is a mysterious candy box. Tap it and some candy will fall out. Take turns in tapping on the candy box to drop the candy out and collect them. Will you drop them out little by little or go all in?

games.name: Diver Go!
games.description: "Are you ready? Diver, Go!"Dive in search of the treasure coins lying on the ocean floor!But watch out for King Octo's curse which causes the coins in front of you to disappear mysteriously!Gather the required coins and sell them back to the coin collector on the boat.

games.name: Hatsuden
games.description: Hatsuden is a game of power generation. Build your power plant larger than your rival's, but at the same time, you need to supply just the right amount of electricity to your city.A suspenseful gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat until the very end. Will you be the best 'Hatsuden' engineer?

games.name: Hits & Outs
games.description: Hits & Outs is a fun game inspired by the strategic battle of wits between the pitcher and batter in baseball.Enjoy the thrilling moments without having to keep track of player statistics. As the name suggests, there are no balls or strikes in this game, only hits and outs!Each game takes only three innings long! Enjoy this thrilling game with tactical exchanges on the field!

games.name: Nice Egg! Deluxe
games.description: A new Nice Egg has arrived, featuring Bacon, Lettuce, and Tomatoes! Join in the fried-egg party and set your sights on getting a 'Nice Egg'!In Nice Egg! Deluxe crack the egg and drop the yolk. Collect bacon, lettuce and tomatoes. Become the star of the party by collecting all 3!

games.name: Pack-Back Robot
games.description: 'Pack Pack! Back Back!'Pack-Back Robot is a 2 player energy collection game. Feed your robots with energy cubes!The game is played in 2 phases. Simultaneously race to feed your robots. Then once you've gathered enough use the cubes to charge up the energy. You'll need a keen eye to collect the colors that match your energy meter. But charging up the meter might not be as easy as it seems.

games.name: Ping Pond Frog!
games.description: Ping Pond Frog! is a fun frog hopping game!Bounce the frog and make it jump off the lily pad to the other side of the pond and collect the targets!The center targets may help either of you achieve your goals.Fun antics await you in the pond!

games.name: TOKYO HIGHWAY Rainbow City
games.description: Build your own way!Build and grow your own highway unique highway that crosses over or under the other player's highways. Be the first to place down all your cars, or enjoy scoring points with the Mission rules!

games.name: Tower of Doubt
games.description: Scout and secure the more valuable towers. But you and your opponent can only see one side of the tower. Watch each other’s moves to ascertain the tower’s true worth. Will your guesses be right or wrong? When dawn breaks on this night of suspicion and doubt, the truth about the tower will be revealed!

games.name: Viking See-Saw
games.description: Viking See-Saw is an exciting game where players race to load their cargo before the ship tilts. If the ship’s seesaw tips due to the weight, you’ll incur a penalty!You'll need to plan when and wear you want to load your pieces and get all your cargo onto the boat before anyone else!

games.name: Wonder Bowling
games.description: Wonder Bowling is a quirky bowling game. Instead of bowling the ball, tap the bowling lane with the stick to knock down pins using vibrations. But don't knock down all the pins! You'll need to try and keep a number of pins standing to reach your targets. If only one pin is left standing, you get a "Strike!"

games.name: The Rocketeers Guide to Rocketships
games.description: If you ever wanted to defend Planet Earth like Flash Gordon or Buck Rogers then Take control of your Rocketships in a fast paced exciting game of Tactical Space Warfare in 1950's Retrofuture.

games.name: Glorious Revolution
games.description: It is 1688; William of Orange has landed with over 14,000 troops.As the Stuart regime crumbles the more corrupt Chief Justices flee to safety taking with them as much loot as they can muster to ensure a comfortable retirement in exile.Each player takes on the role of one of our fugitive Judges and their two agents who will roam across England visiting supporters and arranging for shipping of valuable donations to Carlisle ready for their lord’s escape into Scotland.As the players collect these donations the forces of the Glorious Revolution sweep across England and Wales seizing prop-erties an

games.name: No Place Like Homebrew
games.description: Creating a living, breathing homebrew world doesn’t have to be hard. No Place Like Homebrew gives you hundreds of settlements, factions, NPCs, monsters and more, all designed to slot seamlessly into your fantasy RPG campaigns.The book is perfect for when your players wander off the beaten track, or when you just want to add something surprising and fresh to your world. games.name: The Deck Of Wondrous Items
games.description: The Deck of Wondrous Items is a pack of 78 Tarot-sized unique item/lore cards for DnD. Designed to blend perfectly with your games with fully illustrated home brew items to help heighten your experience, with a few familiar items thrown in with a wondrous twist!

games.name: Ace of Spades
games.description: Ace of Spades is a single-player game, or a two-player game if you prefer to play it in co-op mode, that uses poker mechanics to resolve dangerous duels against the worst spawns from Hell. Your path of vengeance has led you to Sweet Haven, Arizona. You know that the necromancer who has ruined your life has taken over the cemetery as his base of operations and you are going to finish him off at all costs. You face Lord Killmister, a supernatural being, but your prowess as a gambler goes beyond sleight of hand.Channel your magic through poker plays to take out Lord Killmister’s minions one by on

games.name: Berlin 1960
games.description: Cold War tensions run high as spies, double agents, and informants move unseen through the divided city.Trust no one, outwit and uncover your enemies in this game of hidden roles and deception for a large group of daring players. In this game set in the German capital during the Cold War, you’ll assume the identity of a member of the CIA or the KGB. Throughout the game, you’ll use various powers to try to identify your fellow agents and hinder your rivals’ investigations and communications. However, every action counts, and the signals you send to your allies may be misinterpret

games.name: Match Madness
games.description: Let the furious fun begin! Players sprint to arrange a set of 5 blocks so that they match a pattern shown on a card. First player to succeed grabs the card and a new matching race starts. Tensions rise as you scramble to outpace and outsmart your opponents in this ingenious game of perception. So fire-up your neurons and be transported by Match Madness®!

games.name: Oh My Word
games.description: Oh My Word is a real-time party word game that features a constantly changing playing field, a random timer, and unusual categories.To play, you determine a letter, search for a category on the playing field, name a suitable term, and cover the category before the timer catches up with you.

games.name: Orloj : The Prague Astronomical Clock
games.description: From the heart of Prague’s Old Town, the ancient Astronomical Clock, known as the Orloj, marks the passage of time with its intricate mechanism and enigmatic figures. A marvel of medieval technology that has endured to this day. In this game, you take on the role of a master builder competing to leave your mark on history by adding the legendary and majestic calendar to the ancient Orloj. games.name: Temple Twist
games.description: A cryptic notebook leads your archaeological expedition to an ancient temple deep in the jungle, rumoured to hold incredible artifacts. Your goal: explore the rooms of the temple and escape before your energy runs out! But that’s easier said than done, because the temple is a maze of movable walls and mysterious mechanisms! Now it’s time to work together. Using your action cards, you’ll navigate through this unique structure, move walls, and even rotate the entire temple! Temple Twist is an action-packed cooperative game that’s fun for the whole family. Players take turns choosing an act

games.name: The Game of Birds
games.description: In this card game, players compete to become the most successful conservator of threatened birds. They do this by protecting birds from modern threats while building a strong avian portfolio that improves their chances of survival. Gameplay is inspired by the “Seven Wonders” of birdlife: Nest, Flight, Feather, Egg, Beak, Migration, and Song.

games.name: The Gang: More Players Expansion for 7-10 Players
games.description: More chips and new mechanics let you build a team of up to ten players to pull off the heist of the century! Get the whole gang together!This expansion allows you to play The Gang with up to ten players. You can also use the included “exit chips” to simplify the game for five and six players. This expansion is only playable with the base game The Gang.

games.name: White Castle Duel
games.description: In the 16th century, Japan began trading with the West after the arrival of Portuguese merchants and Jesuit missionaries. Himeji Castle, a symbol of feudal power, was a strategic enclave where exotic goods arrived that soon altered the balance of power between the clans. In The White Castle: Duel, two clans compete for influence over Himeji’s court and Daimyo. games.name: Wildblooms
games.description: Plant seeds and let your flowers flourish! Clever planning and a little luck will transform an empty meadow into a thriving ecosystem. Can you get multiple wildflowers to bloom at once? Use combo effects strategically to grow your flowers and create the largest meadow.

games.name: Big Black Deck (Expansion)
games.description: This is the after-midnight version of Probably Illegal. The Big Black Deck adds darker scenarios, dirtier objects, and morally bankrupt skills that push the table into uncomfortable yet hilarious territory. Mixed rite into the base game. Think cult cover-ups, blackmail, orgy disasters matched with plans that absolutely should not work but might.It’s unapologetically adult, cleverly twisted, and built for players who want the game to feel a little dangerous.If the base game is a heist movie, this is the directors cut.

games.name: Probably Illegal: The World's Most Dangerous Card Game... Probably
games.description: Probably Illegal is a party game for people who are a little... f*#ked up. (You know who you are.) Each round, one player reads an immoral scenario, and everyone else pitches their brilliant (or terrible) plan using Skill and Object cards of questionable integrity.- Convince a judge your scheme involving a forklift and a fake mustache is the winning move.- Sabotage your friends because friendship is temporary but victory is forever.- Plays in minutes, not the 7 hours your one friend insists DnD "only takes."- Banned in 195 countries. Probably.Game and Expansions: - Probably Illegal - Base

games.name: The White Stuff Bag
games.description: “White Stuff ”Carry Case Looks like evidence but holds your game.The White Stuff Bag is our signature contraband-style carry case , designed to transport your decks like you just walked out of a very questionable transaction.Heavy-duty, collectible, and instantly conversation-starting. Fits the base game and expansions. Perfect for travel, game night flexing, or making airport security slightly nervous.Not drugs. Definitely just a card game. Probably.

games.name: Malediction - Liena and Griza Expansion
games.description: Liena & Griza expands Malediction with two new Seekers, more than 50 new cards, and a wide range of new spells and items that deepen tactical play. The expansion also introduces two-player starter sets, offering new ways to enter the game while enriching long-term strategic depth.

games.description: Gachapon Trick is a sharp, modern trick-taking game that captures the joy of a capsule-toy machine: quick decisions, calculated risks, and the thrill of collecting the perfect set. games.name: Cubyria: Architects of a Lost City
games.description: 3d competitive Tetris on a rotating board. Every game produces a unique and beautiful palace!

games.name: Go Big
games.description: Go Big is a fast, funny, and deceptively tactical card game where bluffing, timing, and bold plays are key to victory. Each turn, you’ll play a set of 1–3 matching cards face-up to your display, hoping they survive until your next turn, because only then can you bank them for points!But nothing is safe in Go Big. games.name: Tulip Season
games.description: At Keukenhof, the festival of tulips in the Netherlands, the tulip fields wash the countryside in gorgeous colour, dotted by the iconic windmills. games.name: Yonder
games.description: The ancients have granted you the charter you need to found a settlement on the distant shore. games.description: A quick, pocket-sized western duel! Use bluff, cunning and dexterity to defeat your opponent! games.name: Monster Freeze
games.description: It's cold! The monsters need to stay warm! And to do that, they need to cuddle up—but only with creatures of their own color! Quickly line up 3 creatures of the same color in a line or diagonally in 3 punched cards stacked together. Get 5 patterns of the same color or 1 pattern of each color to win the game!

games.name: Oh Crab!
games.description: Escape your crab from the seaside fish and chip shop to the sea through a beach full of obstacles!Oh Crab! is a fast-paced, skill-based racing game where you build your deck of cards. games.name: Skalvenia
games.description: Step into the role of a jarl and lead your Viking clan to glory through the colonization of a new land, worship of ancient gods, and glorious battles. Sail your drakkar to an uncharted realm to establish the first settlements there. Carefully balance the conquest of new territories with the development of your capital in the Old Land.Skalvenia is a Lite 4X board game planned for crowdfunding launch in Q1 next year. Visit our booth to discover and play it. Play with 2–4 players and choose between a full game or just a few rounds - whatever suits you best.

games.name: Wedding Seating Chart (Polish/English edition)
games.description: Seat your guests at the wedding table so that everyone has a great time and doesn't spoil the fun for others.Wedding guests have their own requirements and preferences. How can you please everyone?That's the goal!"The first wedding guests are already entering the hall! The staff is waiting with champagne, the DJ is preparing a song for the first dance... games.name: West Story: A Town Building Game
games.description: In West Story, players build their own Wild West towns by purchasing cards for their player boards. They aim to improve their available actions and score the most victory points. games.name: All Falls Down: Sorroborough

games.name: Seven Strikes
games.description: Seven Strikes is a GM-less, story-driven jubensha designed for five players, blending social deduction, immersive roleplay, and modern political storytelling into a single evening experience.Inspired by true-crime narratives and interactive theatre, the game asks players not just what happened, but who gets believed. WELCOME TO NORTH EAST LONDON. SOMETHING IS ABOUT TO BREAK.Five strangers sit around a table in a tired community centre on the edge of the city. They don’t know each other. games.description: Welcome to the Spy of the Year awards ceremony!Your group of S.E.C.R.E.T. agents (and handler) are here to have a nice time and hopefully win some awards. With all the world’s greatest deceivers, tricksters and double-crossers in one place, surely nothing can go wrong. At the very least you can trust everyone at this table… right? You all have your own secrets to hide but there is a mole in your midst. Can you find out each other’s secrets while hiding your own? Go

games.name: FlickFleet: Box of Xeno Flicks 1
games.description: The sixth expansion for the tabletop space battle dexterity game, Box of Xeno Flicks 1 adds loads of new ship types to the alien fleets added in FlickFleet: Xeno Wars.

games.name: Gal4Xeon
games.description: Gal4Xeon is a print and play roll and write game where you explore the galaxy, expanding your territory, exploiting resources and then trading with of conquering the aliens you meet along the way.

games.name: Cat Spotting
games.description: Cat Spotting is a fun, fast 2-player game where the objective is simple: be the first to spot the hidden cat in the crowd!

games.name: Muster: Raise the Banners
games.description: 🧙‍♂️ Step into the enchanting realms of Muster, a family-friendly 2-player game for ages 8 and up where players compete to Raise the Banners and seize control of five majestic castles.

games.name: Muster: The Expansions Season One
games.description: Introducing two cataclysmic micro-expansions for our hit indie lane battler Muster: Raise the Banners... Pyroclasm + High and Mighty.Drop by our stand to check out prototypes… and maybe even score a demo. Coming to Kickstarter in 2026!

games.name: One Card Maze
games.description: Get lost in a brain-twisting, pocket-sized maze gameOne Card Maze is a maze that twists and turns around a single card. Travel through the maze by rotating and flipping the card to unlock doors. As you do, the maze will look different in changing orientations. Getting lost is all part of the game!This pocket sized, in-hand solo game is perfect for board game lovers and puzzle geeks alike. Let's get lost!The One Card Maze collection includes five unique wallets with 18 exciting mazes in each.

games.name: Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas
games.description: Join us a preview of our upcoming game, Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas!You can book a demo slot here, or just show up at our stand to have a quick look!About the gamePrototype game boxHarness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or ride currents and hunt whales as the relentless whaleboat crew, in this asymmetric board game for 1 to 6 players.As Moby Dick, you control the mighty white whale and other whales appearing in the ocean. games.name: Onward
games.description: Onward is a competitive strategy game for 2 to 4 players that lasts about 1 hour. It is the spiritual successor to Skytear, the competitive card-driven game inspired by MOBA video games such as League of Legends or DOTA2.

games.name: Amelia's Secret
games.description: Immersive Escape Game in augmented reality. Once the cards are placed in the room, the doors of the mansion close on you. To get out of your new home, you will have to find the secret before the evil spirit imprisons you forever! Free companion app to play with on Google Play and Apple Store.

games.name: Little Explorers
games.description: Immersive treasure hunts in augmented reality. Place the AR markers anywhere around the home or the garden and the hunt can start! Once the app is installed, no need wifi to play, kids (and parents!) run around to find the next symbol to scan. Players compete on a variable city map through purchasing, marketing and sales, and on a job market for key staff members. This is the ULTIMATE version of the game with deluxe miniatures, double-layer components, and upgraded components.Limited quantity available.

games.name: Purramid
games.description: Purrramid is a wacky family game with a push-your-luck dice mechanic.​ Help Grandma put all her kittens to bed - she has a lot of them!​ The cats love to sleep next to each other (and on top of each other), so it takes a bit of creativity. ​The first player to tuck all their assigned kittens in wins!
